BL-1380 — The paused-pager Expedite route records a bare approval, so expediting a ticket that posed a choice writes approved, discards the choice, and leaves the coder with a question nobody will ever be asked again
What it solves: No `required_wiring:`, and the reason is specific rather than a shrug. The
natural anchor would be `classifyApprovalRulingRequirement` in
`bridgeServer.ts` — but BL-1367 already put that string in that file for the
Approve route, so a substring match cannot tell this route's call site from
the exis…
Approval context: This one is about your phone, which is why the shape is yours rather than mine. The defect is not in question and I am not asking about it. . Tapping Expedite on a ticket that posed a choice currently writes human_approval approved with no ruling. The ask stops being pending, so you are never shown…
BL-1380 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1380" (or "reject BL-1380 <reason>") to act.
